purpose: Sourced household quality/storage references, not measured item-level expiry or model training labels.

temperature_policy.counter: Cool indoor conditions, generally around 20–21°C; follow the individual source conditions. Hot rooms can shorten quality windows.
temperature_policy.refrigerator: Household refrigerator at or below 4°C; cold-sensitive produce can lose quality.

age_policy: Subtract all reported elapsed days from the matching reference; changing storage location or recording no spoilage does not reset age. A ripeness-specific range is conditional on that maturity; using full purchase age is a conservative comparison.

records.source_temperature: Household fruit bowl; EUFIC specifies around 20°C
notes: Keep away from direct sunlight and heat. This is a general whole-banana range; already overripe fruit may have less time.

records.source_temperature: 33–40°F in source; app assumes refrigerator at or below 4°C
notes: Ripen on the counter first; chill ripe bananas if needed.

records.source_locator: Temperature Management, page 1: ambient deterioration after 3–4 days
records.source_temperature: Ambient temperature; exact temperature not specified
notes: Use promptly. This ambient range describes onset of quality deterioration after harvest, not a measured safety cutoff. Earlier handling can shorten it.

records.source_temperature: Household refrigerator; source gives no exact temperature
notes: Keep whole in a loose bag and cut shortly before preparation. Bitter melon is chilling-sensitive; do not substitute commercial 10°C storage times for a household fridge.

records.source_locator: Storage advice: cucumber with skin, fruit bowl
records.source_temperature: Household fruit bowl; not a hot outdoor setting
notes: Keep whole with its original shrink-wrap if supplied, in a cool indoor spot. Cut cucumber must be refrigerated. Heat and drying can shorten this window.

records.source_temperature: 33–40°F in source; app assumes refrigerator at or below 4°C
notes: Keep refrigerated and inspect for soft or damaged areas. Cucumbers are chilling-sensitive; refrigeration need not improve flavor or exceed the counter window.

records.source_temperature: Room temperature; exact temperature not specified
notes: Use promptly and avoid bruising. Keep away from direct sun and hot appliances.

records.source_temperature: 33–40°F in source; app assumes refrigerator at or below 4°C
notes: Use promptly; avoid bruising and check its condition before preparation. Cold can affect quality.

records.source_temperature: Room temperature; exact temperature not specified
notes: Keep whole citrus in a cool indoor spot and inspect regularly.

records.source_temperature: 33–40°F in source; app assumes refrigerator at or below 4°C
notes: Keep whole citrus in the refrigerator for this general quality window.

records.source_locator: Store at room temperature (70°F/21°C): Papaya, mangos
notes: Keep whole in a cool indoor spot and check ripeness daily. This is not a prediction of when a green papaya will ripen.

records.source_temperature: Refrigerator after ripening; exact temperature not specified
notes: Ripen before refrigeration; use promptly once ripe. The source gives a 4–7 day ripe-fruit keeping window.

records.source_locator: Store Well Waste Less: whole pineapple
records.source_temperature: Room temperature; exact temperature not specified
notes: Store whole away from heat and sunlight. Cut pineapple belongs in the refrigerator.

records.source_temperature: 33–40°F in source; app assumes refrigerator at or below 4°C
notes: Use this whole-fruit refrigerator range as general guidance, not a ripening countdown.

records.source_locator: Storing Fresh Tomatoes, page 2: ripe retail tomatoes
records.source_temperature: Room temperature, away from sunlight
notes: Store ripe tomatoes away from direct sunlight and use promptly. Unripe tomato ripening time is a separate process.

records.source_locator: Food Safety and Storage: ripe tomatoes
records.source_temperature: Refrigerator crisper; exact temperature not specified
notes: Only refrigerate ripe tomatoes for this short window; chilling may reduce flavor and texture.
